title: Research: exact fibre O(wV) invoice for PR2753 route_cube (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

[#2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753) states that owner routes still use `O_q(wV)` implementations. This package binds that asymptotic charge to an exact, checkable fibre work invoice on the retained `routes.route_cube` bytes (vendor digest authenticated; PR2753 head `7dba5452a4071a856a0b11cebdcd2d3b6bcd7659` unchanged).

On the pinned routine, fibre payload `copy_bits` writes are exactly

| Regime | Partition calls | Fibre `copy_bits` writes |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `cap > 1` | `d² L` | `(2 d² L + 2) V` |
| `cap = 1` (`w = 1`) | `0` | `2 V` |

with `M = q^w`, `L = bit_length(M)+1`, `cap = M/q`, `H = cap^(d²)`, `V = H F`. For every checked `w ≥ 2` fixture this is at least `2 w V`, matching the stated `O_q(wV)` route charge on this reached primitive.

This answers open question 2 of `docs/research/selected-bit-caller-storage-map.md` for the **route** path only: an exact work lower bound on the retained decorated-key cube under complete-prefix order as implemented. It does not claim that every correct router needs `Ω(wV)`, does not replace the routine by an H2 primitive, does not price ordinary leaf `atom_swap`, and does not change the selected decimal.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/pr2753-route-cube-owv-fibre/`
- Tip: `afcbc8468c9f0e154bca7557aadd562f5195c479`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — exact fibre invoice for pinned `route_cube` only

Closest prior: merged [#2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753) (recursive BIT caller and stated `O(wV)` baseline). Soft overlap ≈0.42: complementary exactification of the retained owner-route charge, not a ~0.9 retarget of `binary-digit-cost-audit` or `selected-route-live-volume`. Related [#2809](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2809) (physical caller), [#2708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2708) (live-volume storage).

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/pr2753-route-cube-owv-fibre/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/pr2753-route-cube-owv-fibre/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/pr2753-route-cube-owv-fibre/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/pr2753-route-cube-owv-fibre/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr2753-route-cube-owv-fibre
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PR2753_ROUTE_CUBE_OWV_FIBRE fixtures=6 cursor_bits=[3, 5, 6, 8]
PASS_INDEPENDENT_PR2753_ROUTE_CUBE_OWV_FIBRE fixtures=6
PASS_PR2753_ROUTE_CUBE_OWV_FIBRE_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr2753-route-cube-owv-fibre outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`. A temporary copy of `CERTIFICATE.json` with corrupted fibre totals is rejected, and duplicate JSON keys are rejected. `independent.py` does not import `verify.py`/`model.py`.

Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can an exact total-traffic invoice (key appends, `high_key` numerical work, Counter drains) replace the fibre-only lower bound? Fibre `copy_bits` already matches `O(wV)`; full tape traffic would sharpen bootstrap constants.
2. Does the ordinary leaf `atom_swap` path admit a similarly exact matching `Ω(wV)` invoice without retargeting `binary-digit-cost-audit`?
